stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Joe's Scary Team has been laid to rest (14.72 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy vs Mr. Action Jackson, playoff odds win/loss: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy 57%/17%, Mr. Action Jackson 78%/39%.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Claremont In Yo Stace! vs The Mahomies. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Claremont In Yo Stace! 85% / 54%, The Mahomies 34% / 6%.
✅ CLINCHED: Brock You Like a Hurricane has locked up the #1 seed and a bye.
🏈 100-YARD RUSH: Ruffing the Passer ripped off a 26-yard run last week, 29% → 55% playoff odds. Hit the hole and never looked back.

🤝 HINDSIGHT DEPT.: 5 weeks ago we said The Mahomies should get Bo Nix and Parker Washington from Ramosverse. Since: Bo Nix and Parker Washington 138.84 pts, Devaughn Vele and Jeremiyah Love 40.40 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy: 67% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 14% with none (now 42%).
🚪 BYE WATCH: Mr. Action Jackson needs to beat Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy to stay in the bye race (7.7% with a win, 0.5% with a loss).
📝 REPORT CARDS ARE OUT: Brock You Like a Hurricane A (scoring A+, record A+); Kirbo Crushers D- (record F, scoring F).
🚑 INJURY WARD: Mr. Action Jackson is absolutely slammed — Nacua (Rd 1) and Jackson (Rd 3) are out.
🏆 Title odds entering Week 12: Brock You Like a Hurricane 42%, Gibb it to Me Baby 20%, Kyle Tucker 11%.
📰 Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high-pressure' situation for Commanders. That's TDsMaGee's starting QB. Take note.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 0.5% against Kirbo Crushers — and won.
💓 Brock You Like a Hurricane outlasted 49er Faith-Fool after the favorite flipped 9 times.
